messages:
alex: Quick kickoff for CloudPartner refkit (GCP + Azure). Partner wants a tiny TF repo: core network, compute module, and example app that runs a single inference call. POC in 10 business days.

marta: Agreed. Keep defaults opinionated: GKE Autopilot and AKS managed. We'll provide advanced examples for custom k8s later.

yusuf: For modules, propose `core` (VPC, IAM), `k8s_compute` (nodepool autoscale), and `app` (k8s manifests + cache sidecar). Minimal vars: region/project, env, node_min, node_max, cpu_arch, enable_cache.

alex: CI plan: GH Actions matrix for amd64/arm64, publish multi-arch manifests to partner registry or give build steps. Smoke test should curl /health and run a short prompt.

marta: Marketplace asks: `partner.yml`, short runbook, and a validation container that checks health + certs. I'll draft runbook and a small cost table.

yusuf: Networking default: create lightweight VPC when `vpc_id` not provided. Add `private_only` toggle for compliance. Document peering notes.

ci-bot: Workflow queued: refkit-cloudpartner/ci/build-matrix  3 jobs.

alex: Ownership: Alex (partner PM), Marta (docs + marketplace), Yusuf (TF modules + CI). I'll create repo skeleton today and open PR.

marta: I'll add Terraform snippet for partner docs and a short troubleshooting FAQ.

yusuf: I'll tag modules semver and add `module_version` output.

alex: Meeting check: sync next Tue 11am PT if blockers. Otherwise update the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.example/partners/cloudpartner-refkit.
